raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: "elpa"
  version: "2026.02.002"
  elpa_suffix: ${{ "_onenode" if mpi == "nompi" else "" }}
  mpi_prefix: ${{ "nompi" if mpi == "nompi" else "mpi_" + mpi }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://elpa.mpcdf.mpg.de/software/tarball-archive/Releases/${{ version }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 02e3c59fec53cd8eb66a4cc15fa4fbf190cf9654227223fb8ad55713e9427932
  patches:
    - check_thread_affinity.patch
    - includedir-suffix.patch
    - pkgconf.patch

build:
  number: ${{ 1 + (100 if mpi == "nompi" else 0) }}
  skip:
    - osx and arm64 and mpi == "openmpi"
    - win
  string: mpi_${{ mpi }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ compiler("fortran") }}
    - if: unix
      then: gnuconfig
    - make
    - perl
    - pkg-config
  host:
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then:
        - ${{ mpi }}
        - scalapack
    - _openmp_mutex
    - libblas
    - liblapack
    - "libopenblas * *openmp*"
  run:
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then:
        - ${{ mpi }}
        - scalapack
    - _openmp_mutex
    - libblas
    - liblapack
    - "libopenblas * *openmp*"
    - pkg-config

tests:
  - package_contents:
      lib:
        - ${{ name }}${{ elpa_suffix }}
        - ${{ name }}${{ elpa_suffix }}_openmp
  - script:
      - if: target_platform == build_platform
        then:
          # pkg-config checks
          - pkg-config --exists ${{ name }}${{ elpa_suffix }}
          - pkg-config --exists ${{ name }}${{ elpa_suffix }}_openmp
          # Binary execution checks
          - ${{ name }}2_print_kernels${{ elpa_suffix }}
          - ${{ name }}2_print_kernels${{ elpa_suffix }}_openmp

about:
  homepage: https://elpa.mpcdf.mpg.de/
  license: LGPL-3.0-only
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - COPYING/COPYING
    - COPYING/gpl.txt
    - COPYING/lgpl.txt
  summary: Eigenvalue Solvers for Petaflop-Applications
  description: |
    The computation of selected or all eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a symmetric
    (Hermitian) matrix has high relevance for various scientific disciplines.
    For the calculation of a significant part of the eigensystem typically direct
    eigensolvers are used. For large problems, the eigensystem calculations with
    existing solvers can become the computational bottleneck.
  documentation: https://elpa.mpcdf.mpg.de/documentation/
  repository: https://gitlab.mpcdf.mpg.de/elpa/elpa

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
    - awvwgk
    - yuzie007
    - mkrack
